### Knowing God’s Assured Calling on Your Life
Author: Jack Graham (PowerPoint Ministries)
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-apr-4-2011.html
Passage: Malachi 1:2-3
Points:
- In biblical terms, God's love and hate refer to His sovereign choices and actions rather than mere human emotions.
- Esau represents those who discard spiritual realities for worldly desires, while Jacob represents God's covenant people.
- Human salvation does not originate from personal exertion or human will, but rests solely on God's mercy.
- Believers can rest with total assurance knowing that God initiated their redemption and holds them securely in His grip.
